title: As the Deer Panteth
lyrics_original: As the deer panteth for the water
So my soul longeth after thee
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship thee
You alone are my strength, my shield
To you alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship thee
You're my friend and you are my brother
Even though you are a king
I love you more than any other
So much more than anything
You alone are my strength, my shield
To you alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship thee
I love you more than gold or silver,
only you can satisfy.
You alone are the real joy giver
and the apple of my eye.
You alone are my strength, my shield
To you alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you

bible_verses.telugu: దుప్పి నీటివాగులకొరకు ఆశపడునట్లు దేవా, నీకొరకు నా ప్రాణము ఆశపడుచున్నది.
bible_verses.english: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా నా ఆశ్రయము, నా కేడెము నా హృదయము ఆయనయందు నమి్మకయుంచెన గనుక నాకు సహాయము కలిగెను. కావున నా హృదయము ప్రహర్షించుచున్నది కీర్తనలతో నేను ఆయనను స్తుతించుచున్నాను.
bible_verses.english: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆకాశమందు నీవు తప్ప నాకెవరున్నారు? నీవు నాకుండగా లోకములోనిది ఏదియు నా కక్కర లేదు.
bible_verses.english: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, my soul truly longs for You above all else. You are my strength when I am weak, my safe shield in trouble, and the deepest desire of my heart. Thank You for being both my exalted King and my closest friend. Today, I yield my spirit to You and find my rest in Your tender presence. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, my soul truly longs for You above all else. You are my strength when I am weak, my safe shield in trouble, and the deepest desire of my heart. Thank You for being both my exalted King and my closest friend. Today, I yield my spirit to You and find my rest in Your tender presence. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Just as a deer searches desperately for water in a dry land, our souls are created with an inner thirst that only God can satisfy. In a world full of temporary distractions, this song gently redirects our gaze back to Jesus—our strength, our protector, and the true desire of our hearts. He is not only the sovereign King of the universe, but also a loving friend who invites us into deep intimacy. Today, take a moment to rest in His presence and allow Him to refresh your longing soul.
